regime.note: standardised z = phi/sigma; refocused mean arm, so the linear term is the smallest of the three and kappa is ill-conditioned

amplification_ceiling.note: the design sits just inside the axis-angle wrap by construction; selftest H7 fails if a change pushes it over

operating_point.E0_note: the hard pulse is an EXACT echo at even reps (U^2 = -I for all phi), so E0 must run unamplified at reps=1 or the null is vacuous; |eps| reaches 0.8 rad there, well clear of the floor

predictor_delivery.note: R_offset/R_pred with the step realised as dc = J^+ step at the OPTIMISED mean control. At the unoptimised c0 the same move gives a NEGATIVE R at every sigma -- the delivery fraction is a property of where you stand.

E0_null.falsifies: a substantial measured gain means the injected ensemble is not what we injected

E1_characterise.measure: eps_k, L_k, mean L, CVaR_alpha, d_alpha

E2_predictor_PRIMARY.control: mean-optimal + dc = J^+ step, step from E1's OWN measured d_alpha
E2_predictor_PRIMARY.note: this is the primary endpoint: a measurement-only quantity predicting where tail-risk control departs is the novel Stage 6 claim, not that CVaR differs

E3_arm_vs_arm.note: secondary: confirms the gain is real, but uses a control optimised offline

E4_replication.note: shot feasibility not yet emulated at this sigma

discriminator: mean_loss_change must be POSITIVE at E2 and E3; a negative value means the mean arm was not converged and the gain is baseline slack, not a tail trade

analysis_frozen.debias: subtract 3/(6*shots) from each L before forming CVaR
analysis_frozen.cvar: atomic upper-tail CVaR, as in every prior stage
analysis_frozen.pairing: the SAME phi draws across all arms

calibration.id: C1 RX(pi) is a pi pulse
calibration.fails_like: a miscalibrated pi pulse looks like a static e0 offset, which is exactly the quantity the predictor keys on

calibration.id: C2 fractional RX(theta) is monotone and linear in theta
calibration.circuits: RX(theta) on |0> for theta in 0..pi in 13 steps, measure Z
calibration.fails_like: if fractional gates are silently synthesised from pi/2 pulses the control family is not the one we optimised over and every theta_i means something else

calibration.circuits: RY(pi/2), RZ(psi), RY(-pi/2) on |0> for psi in 0..2pi, measure Z; and a long RZ chain of 200 with net angle 0
calibration.expect: cos(psi) curve; the null chain returns |0> with no extra loss
calibration.fails_like: if RZ costs time or error the injected ensemble picks up a decoherence background that scales with |phi|, which mimics a tail

calibration.id: C4 six-circuit Bloch reconstruction returns a known gate
calibration.circuits: the six-circuit set with c = c0, phi = 0, 1024 shots
calibration.fails_like: a basis-change sign error flips a component of d_alpha and the predicted step points the wrong way

calibration.circuits: 10 circuits x 256 shots, batched as the science run will be
calibration.expect: record reported usage; pass it as --throughput
calibration.fails_like: the 2000 shots/s default is a guess and the budget is linear in it
